annotations.title: Financials in one template across US GAAP and IFRS

description: A company's income statement, balance sheet and cash flow in one template whether it files US GAAP or IFRS, 26 lines with 14 ratios, each figure saying which tag it came from or the arithmetic that made it. One company over up to 10 fiscal years, or up to five side by side (Apple beside TSMC beside SAP), optionally in US dollars at each year's average and year-end rates. From annual reports at SEC, restatements applied.

companies.description: One company for its years, or up to five side by side (latest fiscal year each): tickers (AAPL, TSM), CIKs or names.

in_usd.description: Convert a non-dollar filer's amounts to US dollars: flows at the fiscal year's average rate, balances at its year-end rate (the local server, which reads prices). Default false.

years.description: Fiscal years for one company. Default 5.

name: standardized_financials

outputSchema.description: statements (one company, years as columns) or compare (companies as columns) holds the template's lines; how gives each figure's tag or derivation in the same shape; ratios are unitless.

title: Financials in one template across US GAAP and IFRS
